params.name: hex
params.description: Color as a hex code without the

params.name: rgb
params.description: Color as comma-separated RGB values (e.g., 0,71,171) or rgb(0,71,171).

params.name: hsl
params.description: Color as HSL values (e.g., 215,100%,34%) or hsl(215,100%,34%).

params.name: cmyk
params.description: Color as CMYK values (e.g., 100,58,0,33) or cmyk(100,58,0,33).

params.name: w
params.description: Image width in pixels for SVG format responses.

params.name: named
params.description: Whether to include the color name on SVG image outputs.

items.docs: Retrieve comprehensive information for a color provided in any supported format (hex, RGB, HSL, or CMYK). Returns conversions to all other color formats, the nearest named color, image URLs, and contrast color.
